    # Apply rotation

    # Ellipsoid component with different scaling

    # Sine wave modulation

    # Combine all components

        0.6 * ellipsoid_term
        + 0.2 * quadratic_term
        + 0.1 * skewed_term
        + 0.1 * sine_term
    )

    return result
